issues.detail: The Greek 'απολυθεντες' (having been released/set free) is translated as 'Khi được thả ra' (When [they] were released). While the meaning is similar, the Greek uses a perfect passive participle ('having been'), which emphasizes the completed state of being released before they went to their people. The Vietnamese construction 'Khi...' (When...) can imply a simple temporal sequence rather than the completed action/state required by the Greek grammar.
